L2: # Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d) VLA Training & Evaluation
L3: 
L4: Munich, Bavaria, Germany
L5: 
L6: [Button: Join us]
L7: 
L8: The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d) VLA Training & Evaluation, who will build the frameworks for fine-tuning and benchmarking robot foundation models on collected robot data. The frameworks are meant to work across different foundation models and for teams with modest data and compute.
L9: ### Responsibilities
L10:   * Training Workflows: Build reusable, model-agnostic training and evaluation workflows, with experiment tracking, model versioning, and checkpoint management, so that different foundation models can be swapped in without rebuilding the pipeline.
L11:   * Fine-Tuning: Implement fine-tuning of pretrained vision-language-action models on collected robot data, for example with parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA or adapters, or with distillation.
L12:   * Policy Training: Build training loops for action-chunking and transformer-based action models, diffusion policies, and VLM/VLA heads.
L13:   * Benchmarks: Build benchmarks with generalization splits, success metrics, and failure-analysis templates.
L14:   * Transfer Studies: Work with simulation engineers on studies, including metrics and ablations, that test whether improvements in simulation realism improve performance on the real robot.
L15:   * Research Baselines: Turn published methods into working baselines and templates that others can extend.
L16: ### Essential Skills
L17:   * Academic Background: Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field (Master’s or PhD typical), or an equivalent combination of formal training and demonstrated experience training deep learning models.
L18:   * Training Internals: Hands-on experience writing and debugging training loops in PyTorch or JAX, including data loading, loss design, and optimizer behavior.
L19:   * Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning pretrained models and adapting them to new tasks and data.
L20:   * Robot Learning: Working understanding of how imitation-learned policies, such as action-chunking or diffusion policies, turn observations into robot actions.
L21:   * Experiment Management: Experience designing evaluations and ablations, and running experiments with tracking, versioning, and checkpoint management so that others can reproduce them.
L22: ### Beneficial Skills
L23: 
L24:   * VLA Models: Experience fine-tuning vision-language-action or vision-language models for robot control.
L25:   * Real-Robot Evaluation: Experience evaluating learned policies on physical robots.
L26:   * Sim-to-Real: Familiarity with measuring how well models trained in simulation transfer to real hardware.
L27: ### What we offer
L28: 
L29:   * A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
L30: 
L31:   * Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
L32: 
L33:   * Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
L34: 
L35:   * Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
L36: 
L37:   * Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
L38:   * Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment
L39: ### About us
L40: Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.
L41: This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!
L42: 
L43: We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

L8: ## About Anthropic
L9: 
L10: Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
L11: ## About the role
L12: 
L13: As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will drive the adoption of frontier AI by developing bespoke LLM solutions for top enterprises across Japan. You’ll leverage your customer-facing experience and technical skills to architect innovative solutions that address our customers' business needs, meet their technical requirements, and provide a high degree of reliability and safety.
L14: In collaboration with the Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you’ll help enterprise partners incorporate leading-edge AI systems into their products. You will employ your excellent communication skills to explain and demonstrate complex solutions persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You will play a critical role in identifying opportunities to innovate and differentiate our AI systems, while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.
L15: ## Key responsibilities
L16:   * Act as the primary technical advisor for prospective customers across Japan evaluating Claude. Demonstrate how Claude can be used to solve high value business problems by developing system architectures and leveraging novel prompting techniques
L17:   * Partner closely with account executives to understand customer requirements. Configure Claude's capabilities to showcase how it meets the customer's needs. Develop customized pilots and prototypes, as well as evaluation suites to make the case for customer adoption
L18:   * Drive technical decision making by advising on optimal setup, architecture, and integration of Claude into the customer's existing infrastructure
L19:   * Recommend solutions to technical roadblocks
L20:   * Support customer onboarding across Japan by working cross-functionally to ensure successful ramp and adoption. Serve as an ongoing technical advisor throughout implementation and beyond go-live
L21:   * Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and building relationships
L22:   * Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI
L23:   * Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of innovative solutions that leverage our latest models’ capabilities across Japan
L24: ## Minimum qualifications
L25: 
L26:   * Experience as a Technical Product Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, or Platform Engineer
L27:   * Native-level Japanese fluency and business-level English required
L28:   * Designed novel and innovative solutions for technical platforms in a developing business area across Japan
L29:   * Strong technical aptitude to partner with engineers and strong proficiency in Python required
L30: ## Preferred qualifications
L31:   * 4+ years of experience in relevant field
L32:   * Recent experience building production systems with large language models
L33:   * The ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, and to flex into different domains based on the business problem at hand, finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions
L34:   * Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
L35:   * A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
L36:   * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders.
L37:   * Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

L53: ## How we're different
L54: We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science.
L55: We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
L56: The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

L12: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact.
L13: Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains.
L14: Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable: end to end.
L15: 
L16: ABOUT THE ROLE:
L17: Portcast has already been used by global freight forwarding companies, manufacturers and cargo airlines. Our customers trust us to deliver fast, reliable and secure predictions, our engine answers when, where, why, and by how many days a container will be delayed. That trust lives or dies on data quality, and that's what you'll own.
L18: As our Data Analyst, you will be reporting directly to our Analytics Manager and work closely with our Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams. You'll sit on a data-heavy product that gives customers end-to-end visibility of their cargo across the ocean journey, making sure the data we ingest into the models and share with customers is error-free and of the highest quality. You won't just run the query and close the ticket here.
L19: When an anomaly shows up, you'll chase why it's there, trace it to the real source, and fix the process so it doesn't come back. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build.
L20: ### WHAT YOU'LL OWN:
L21: 
L22:   * Documentation, reporting, and root-cause analysis of prediction issues: owning the problem end to end, not just flagging it.
L23: 
L24:   * Analyze ingested and system-generated data for anomalies and gaps, and refer to various data sources to plug those gaps.
L25: 
L26:   * Turn data into stories: surface the pattern behind an issue, propose the fix (QA process-flow change and/or automation), and own the subsequent plan and execution.
L27:   * Automate performance/accuracy review processes, report generation, and data visualization using Python and SQL: building reusable, scalable workflows, not one-off scripts.
L28: 
L29:   * Support Engineering and Data Science on system-level data fixes. Understand how the engine makes predictions, and explore improvements by fixing or introducing new data and features.
L30:   * Support Customer Operations and Marketing with insights from the data: performance, accuracy metrics, the impact of real-time events, as needed.
L31: 
L32:   * Maintain and own internal and customer dashboards based on trial/account requirements (prediction accuracy, timeliness, coverage, explainability).
L33: ### WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
L34: 
L35:   * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
L36:

L51: ### WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

L9: Мы строим корпоративную дата-платформу нового поколения единый self-service путь от источника до витрины. Чем больше пользователей самостоятельно создают пайплайны и витрины, тем важнее встроить качество в саму платформу, а не проверять данные вручную в конце.
L10: Сейчас в SMT есть ручные проверки и автоматические API-тесты, но нет единой сквозной системы. Ищем Data Quality Engineer, который станет техническим владельцем направления в SMT: построит модель, инструменты и процессы, а затем поможет масштабировать их на всю платформу.
L11: Это не роль ручного контролёра: качество остаётся распределённой ответственностью. Инженеры пишут проверки в своих процессах, владельцы отвечают за датасеты, методологию мы формируем вместе с Data Governance. Твоя задача дать им автоматические базовые проверки и понятный self-service инструмент для сложных правил, встроенный в оркестрацию, алертинг и разбор инцидентов.

L13:   * Спроектировать модель качества: измерения, метрики и SLO на датасеты. Определить уровни критичности и пропорциональные требования к проверкам, алертингу и реакции на нарушения.
L14:   * Построить движок проверок и встроить его в жизненный цикл данных: сначала в трансформации и витрины SMT, затем масштабировать на остальные части платформы.
L15:   * Сделать базовые проверки автоматическими: генерировать их из метаданных при создании и обновлении датасетов.
L16:   * Дать пользователям язык для сложных проверок декларативный конфиг, SQL-правила или собственный подход. Выбор за тобой.
L17:   * Реализовать quality gates: карантин, блокировку публикации, остановку пайплайна, fallback или откат там, где это возможно.
L18:   * Настроить наблюдаемость: адресный алертинг, дашборды состояния датасетов, health-score, контроль ложных срабатываний и разбор причин.
L19:   * Использовать lineage из OpenMetadata для impact-анализа и вместе с Data Governance развивать data contracts: сначала в SMT, затем на границе с источниками.
L20:   * Сделать проверки частью инженерного цикла: версионировать их как код, проводить ревью и доставлять через CI/CD.
L21:   * Поддержать миграцию существующих процессов на платформу: построить сверку старого и нового контуров и доказательно подтверждать совпадение цифр.
L22:   * Совместно с Data Governance и владельцами данных задавать стандарты покрытия и ревью. Помогать инженерам применять инструменты, а не писать все проверки за них.
L23:   * Работать с аналитиками как с пользователями: разбираться, где им больно, и делать инструмент, которым пользуются добровольно.

L12: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Finance Data Analyst based in Poland.
L13: As a Finance Data Analyst, you will transform complex financial and operational data into reliable insights that support strategic decision-making and business performance. You will bridge the gap between Finance and technical teams, ensuring data is consistent, accessible, and actionable. Working across finance, revenue, operations, HR, and cloud infrastructure systems, you will help structure datasets, improve reporting, and automate recurring analyses.
L14: You will play a key role in strengthening data quality, standardizing financial metrics, and improving forecasting and performance monitoring. In a fast-evolving, technology-driven environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable reporting processes and support future analytical initiatives. This is an opportunity to combine financial expertise, technical skills, and business curiosity to deliver measurable impact.
L15: ### Accountabilities:
L16:   * Map and document financial and corporate data sources, systems, ownership, definitions, and data flows to improve transparency and consistency.
L17:   * Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, duplication, and reconciliation issues across accounting, billing, CRM, HR, payroll, cash management, and expense-management systems.
L18:   * Define data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, ensuring key financial and operational metrics are clearly defined and consistently calculated.
L19:   * Explore, transform, and model data from data warehouses and connected business systems to create reliable, reusable, and well-documented datasets.
L20:   * Reconcile data across multiple sources and investigate discrepancies to improve the accuracy and reliability of financial and corporate reporting.
L21:   * Produce recurring financial analyses, dashboards, and reporting to support leadership decisions, including budget-versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS performance analysis.
L22:   * Collaborate with data engineering teams and system owners to improve integrations, transformations, data accessibility, and quality checks.
L23:   * Automate recurring reporting, reconciliations, and analytical workflows where automation can deliver meaningful efficiency gains.
L24:   * Maintain documentation covering data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, assumptions, and known limitations.
L25:   * Contribute to data governance and quality monitoring, preparing reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI-driven use cases.
L26:   * Handle confidential financial, HR, and payroll information with discretion, accuracy, and a strong commitment to data protection.
L27: ## Requirements:
L28:   * At least 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, financial analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related analytical role.
L29:   * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data across multiple systems and identify the root causes of discrepancies.
L30:   * Good command of SQL and practical experience with at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool.
L31:   * Ability to translate business questions into clear data requirements, meaningful metrics, and actionable analyses.
L32:   * Solid understanding of financial concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash flow, costs, and unit economics.
L33:   * Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to review, audit, and structure existing financial models.
L34:   * Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both Finance and technical stakeholders.
L35:   * Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.
L36:   * A rigorous, curious, and structured approach to data quality, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and make definitions explicit.
L37:   * Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and deliver practical solutions in a changing business environment.
L38: Nice-to-have qualifications:
L39:   * Experience in a B2B SaaS, software, technology, or scale-up environment.
L40:   * Familiarity with SaaS revenue metrics, including MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.
L41:   * Understanding of SaaS cost structures, including cloud storage, compute, data retention, AI-related expenses, and gross margin.
L42:   * Experience with finance, accounting, billing, CRM, HRIS, payroll, expense-management, or financial planning tools.
L43:   * Knowledge of data warehouses, data modeling, ETL processes, APIs, or data quality frameworks.
L44:   * Experience with Python or another programming language for analysis and automation.
L45:   * Previous exposure to sensitive HR or payroll data and an understanding of the confidentiality requirements involved.
L46: Candidates who meet most, but not necessarily all, of these requirements are encouraged to apply. A strong willingness to learn, analytical thinking, and the ability to demonstrate relevant skills are equally valued.

L48:   * Full-time employment in a role with meaningful exposure to financial strategy and business performance.
L49:   * Opportunity to work in a technology-driven environment alongside Finance, Data Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.

L56: About Cohere Health:
L57: Cohere Health’s clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans’ strategic goals and providers’ needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care.
